enchantments.tooltip: Spellcasting Implement +2: Passive: +2 Implement bonus to Universal Spell Power.
+2 Enhancement Bonus: +2 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Silver Flame Lore +6: Passive: Your Positive, Light, and Alignment spells gain a 6% Equipment bonus to their chance to critical hit.
Power of the Silver Flame +43: Passive: +43 Equipment bonus to Positive, Light, and Alignment Spell Power.

Holy 1: This weapon is wielded by the pure to smite the wicked, dealing an additional 1d6 good damage on each hit. This effect makes the weapon good aligned. Evil characters wielding this weapon will suffer one negative level.
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
